7764-little-bear-at-work-and-at-play.title: At Work And At Play
7764-little-bear-at-work-and-at-play.creator: Frances Margaret Fox
7764-little-bear-at-work-and-at-play.description: A book by Frances Margaret Fox. about the race between the hare and the tortoise, and how the slow-going tortoise was the first to reach the goal because the hare took a nap and did not wake up until after the tortoise had passed him and had won the race.

arxiv-1811-11222.title: Grammars and reinforcement learning for molecule optimization
arxiv-1811-11222.creator: Egor Kraev
arxiv-1811-11222.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Egor Kraev. We seek to automate the design of molecules based on specific chemical properties. Our primary contributions are a simpler method for generating SMILES strings guaranteed to be chemically valid, using a combination of a new context-free grammar for SMILES and additional masking logic; and casting the molecular property optimization as a reinforcement learning problem, specifically best-of-batch policy gradient applied to a Transformer model architecture.

arxiv-2003-00516.title: Neutrinos in curved space-time: particle mixing and flavor oscillations
arxiv-2003-00516.creator: A. Capolupo, G. Lambiase, A. Quaranta
arxiv-2003-00516.description: Abstract We present a quantum field theoretical approach to the vacuum neutrino oscillations in curved space, we analyze the non–trivial interplay between quantum field mixing and field quantization in curved space and derive new oscillation formulae. We compute the formulae explicitly in the spatially flat FLRW metrics for universes dominated by a cosmological constant and by radiation.

arxiv-2111-09890.title: Near-Chandrasekhar-Mass Type Ia Supernovae from the Double-Degenerate Channel Journal: The Astrophysical Journal SeBa ( Toonen et al. 2012 ) , FLASH 4.3 ( Fryxell et al. 2000 ; Dubey et al. 2012 ) , FLASH SN Ia module Townsley et al. 2016 ( http://pages.astronomy.ua.edu/townsley/code ), yt ( Turk et
arxiv-2111-09890.creator: Sudarshan Neopane, Khanak Bhargava, Robert Fisher, Mckenzie Ferrari, Shin’ichirou Yoshida, Silvia Toonen, Eduardo Bravo
arxiv-2111-09890.description: Abstract Recent observational evidence has demonstrated that white dwarf (WD) mergers are a highly efficient mechanism for mass accretion onto WDs in the galaxy. In this paper, we show that WD mergers naturally produce highly-magnetized, uniformly-rotating WDs, including a substantial population within a narrow mass range close to the Chandrasekhar mass ( M Ch M_{\rm Ch} ).

arxiv-2112-05817.title: Exposure-Referred Signal-to-Noise Ratio for Digital Image Sensors
arxiv-2112-05817.creator: Abhiram Gnanasambandam, and Stanley H. Chan
arxiv-2112-05817.description: Abstract The signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is a fundamental tool to measure the performance of an image sensor. However, confusions sometimes arise between the two types of SNRs. The first one is the output-referred SNR which measures the ratio between the signal and the noise seen at the sensor’s output.

arxiv-2208-06021.title: The quest for CMB signatures of Conformal Cyclic Cosmology
arxiv-2208-06021.creator: Dirk Bouwmeester
arxiv-2208-06021.description: Abstract Circles of low-variance and Hawking points in the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB), resulting from black hole mergers and black hole evaporation, respectively, in a previous cycle of the universe, have been predicted as possible evidence for the Conformal Cyclic Cosmology model (CCC) introduced by R. Penrose.

arxiv-2301-04900.title: Stretched and measured neural predictions of complex network dynamics
arxiv-2301-04900.creator: Vaiva Vasiliauskaite, Nino Antulov-Fantulin
arxiv-2301-04900.description: Abstract Differential equations are a ubiquitous tool to study dynamics, ranging from physical systems to complex systems, where a large number of agents interact through a graph with non-trivial topological features. Data-driven approximations of differential equations present a promising alternative to traditional methods for uncovering a model of dynamical systems, especially in complex systems that lack explicit first principles.

arxiv-2305-20047.title: LOWA: Localize Objects in the Wild with Attributes
arxiv-2305-20047.creator: Xiaoyuan GuoMineral xiaoyuanguo@mineral.ai Kezhen Chen Mineral kezhenchen@mineral.ai Jinmeng RaoMineral jinmengrao@mineral.ai Yawen ZhangMineral yawenz@mineral.ai Baochen SunMineral baochens@mineral.ai Jie YangMineral yangjie@mineral.ai
arxiv-2305-20047.description: Abstract We present LOWA, a novel method for localizing objects with attributes effectively in the wild. It aims to address the insufficiency of current open-vocabulary object detectors, which are limited by the lack of instance-level attribute classification and rare class names.

arxiv-2404-18279.title: Out-of-distribution Detection in Medical Image Analysis: A survey
arxiv-2404-18279.creator: Zesheng Hong 1 , Yubiao Yue 2 ,Yubin Chen 3 , Lele Cong 11 , Huanjie Lin 4 , Yuanmei Luo 5 , Mini Han Wang 6 , Weidong Wang 7 , Jialong Xu 2 , Xiaoqi Yang 8 ,Hechang Chen 10 , Zhenzhang Li 9 , Sihong Xie 1

Computer-aided diagnostics has benefited from the development of deep learning-based computer vision techniques in these years.

arxiv-2406-13283.title: Large-Scale Dataset Pruning in Adversarial Training through Data Importance Extrapolation
arxiv-2406-13283.creator: Björn Nieth, Thomas Altstidl, Leo Schwinn, Björn Eskofier
arxiv-2406-13283.description: Abstract Their vulnerability to small, imperceptible attacks limits the adoption of deep learning models to real-world systems. Adversarial training has proven to be one of the most promising strategies against these attacks, at the expense of a substantial increase in training time. With the ongoing trend of integrating large-scale synthetic data this is only expected to increase even further.

arxiv-2408-02373.title: Operationalizing Contextual Integrity in Privacy-Conscious Assistants
arxiv-2408-02373.creator: Sahra Ghalebikesabi, Eugene Bagdasaryan, Ren Yi, Itay Yona, Ilia Shumailov, Aneesh Pappu, Chongyang Shi, Laura Weidinger, Robert Stanforth, Leonard Berrada, Pushmeet Kohli, Po-Sen Huang, Borja Balle
arxiv-2408-02373.description: Abstract Advanced AI assistants combine frontier LLMs and tool access to autonomously perform complex tasks on behalf of users. While the helpfulness of such assistants can increase dramatically with access to user information including emails and documents, this raises privacy concerns about assistants sharing inappropriate information with third parties without user supervision.

arxiv-2411-09154.title: STAR-RIS Enabled ISAC Systems: Joint Rate Splitting and Beamforming Optimization Thanks: Yuan Liu and Yongdong Zhu are with the Research Center for Space Computing System, Zhejiang Laboratory, Hangzhou, 311100, China (e-mail: liuyuan@bjtu.edu.cn, zhuyongdong@hotmail.com). Ruichen Zhang and Dusit Niy
arxiv-2411-09154.creator: Yuan Liu, Ruichen Zhang, Ruihong Jiang, Yongdong Zhu, Huimin Hu
arxiv-2411-09154.description: Abstract This paper delves into an integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) system bolstered by a simultaneously transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surface (STAR-RIS). Within this system, a base station (BS) is equipped with communication and radar capabilities, enabling it to communicate with ground terminals (GTs) and concurrently probe for echo signals from a target of interest.

arxiv-2506-05498.title: Multidimensional Analysis of Specific Language Impairment Using Unsupervised Learning Through PCA and Clustering
arxiv-2506-05498.creator: Niruthiha Selvanayagam
arxiv-2506-05498.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Niruthiha Selvanayagam. Specific Language Impairment (SLI) affects approximately 7 percent of children, presenting as isolated language deficits despite normal cognitive abilities, sensory systems, and supportive environments. Traditional diagnostic approaches often rely on standardized assessments, which may overlook subtle developmental patterns. This study aims to identify natural language development trajectories in children with and without SLI using unsupervised machine learning techniques, providing insights for early identification and targeted interventions.

arxiv-2507-05598.title: Self-Review Framework for Enhancing Instruction Following Capability of LLM
arxiv-2507-05598.creator: Sihyun Park
arxiv-2507-05598.description: Abstract Various techniques have been proposed to improve large language models (LLMs) adherence to formatting and instruction constraints. One of the most effective approaches involves utilizing high-quality data generated by powerful models. However, such models often fail to fully comply with complex instructions in a single generation. To address this limitation, iterative revision methods have been introduced.

For use with patients suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) this might not be the preferable choice because of sight deterioration. Moreover, using a modality different

pmc-10494998.title: The Cost of Maternal Complications and Its Associated Factors Among Mothers Attending Public Hospitals in Harari Region and Dire Dawa City Administration, Eastern Ethiopia: An Institution-Based Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-10494998.creator: Samrawit Shawel, Behailu Hawulte Ayele, Yadeta Dessie, Abera Kenay Tura, Gimaye Dinsa, Abainash Tekola, Miheret Mandefro, Awoke Masrie, Aklilu Tamire, Obsan Kassa Tefasa
pmc-10494998.description: BackgroundPregnant women face high costs for health-care services despite being advertised as free. These costs include non-medical expenses, lost productivity, difficulties caring for family members, and long-term financial impact from complications. Limited research has been done on the cost burden of maternal services and complications, despite numerous studies on maternal health service provision.

pmc-10585447.title: Digital Phenotyping: Data-Driven Psychiatry to Redefine Mental Health
pmc-10585447.creator: Antoine Oudin, Redwan Maatoug, Alexis Bourla, Florian Ferreri, Olivier Bonnot, Bruno Millet, Félix Schoeller, Stéphane Mouchabac, Vladimir Adrien, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso, Sarah Markham, Nicholas Jacobson, Tommaso Martino, Jinying Chen, Robyn Bluhm
pmc-10585447.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The term “digital phenotype” refers to the digital footprint left by patient-environment interactions. It has potential for both research and clinical applications but challenges our conception of health care by opposing 2 distinct approaches to medicine: one centered on illness with the aim of classifying and curing disease, and the other centered on patients, their personal distress, and their lived experiences.

Therefore, the ENTERPRISE (Effects of CPAP on Atherosclerotic Coronary Plaques in Patients with SDB and Coronary Artery Disease) trial aimed to evaluate the effects of adding CPAP therapy to optimal medical treatment on coronary plaques, as evaluated using near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS)–IVUS that can simultaneously detect the plaque morphology and presence of lipid core plaques and is useful for identifying vulnerable

pmc-11641120.title: Physiological and Transcriptional Responses to Phosphorus Deficiency and Glucose-6-Phosphate Supplementation in Neopyropia yezoensis
pmc-11641120.creator: Yujiao Chen, Senhao He, Yinghao Wang, Chuanming Hu, Weitao Cheng, Lingjie Zhou, Nanjing Ji, Haihong Chen, Xin Shen, Setsuko Komatsu, Chiara Lauritano, Miriam Ruocco
pmc-11641120.description: Neopyropia yezoensis, a marine red algae species, has significant economic and ecological value. However, phosphorus (P) deficiency has emerged as a growing concern in many cultivation regions, negatively impacting its growth. To adapt to P deficiency, algae have evolved various strategies, including using dissolved organic phosphorus (DOP) sources to sustain growth.

pmc-12481121.title: An economic and environmental evaluation of Taiwan’s manure to energy applications
pmc-12481121.creator: Chih-Chun Kung, Shuyin Hu, Tsung-Ju Lee, Juan Li
pmc-12481121.description: SummaryCost and benefit information is essential for Taiwan to determine economically feasible manure applications. This study adopts techno-economic analysis and life cycle assessment to evaluate manure’s energy potential under six composting, pyrolysis, and anaerobic digestion possibilities. Biogas fertilizer and biochar use in agriculture is also examined.

pmc-12730348.title: The Mechanisms of Soil Conditioner and Switchgrass in Improving Saline–Alkali Soil: A Field Study in a Semi-Arid Area
pmc-12730348.creator: Yixuan Li, Qing Liu, Longfei Kang, Kaiyu Zhang, Qiang Li, Feng Ai, Vito Butardo, Allan M Showalter
pmc-12730348.description: Simple SummaryThis study explored the synergistic remediation of saline–alkali soils in Northwest China by combining multiple switchgrass (Panicum virgatum L.) cultivars with a coal-based soil conditioner. We assessed the soil physicochemical properties and microbial abundance to identify the optimal switchgrass variety for enhancing soil multifunctionality and the ecological utilization potential of degraded saline–alkali lands.

pmc-12741744.title: Case Report: Long-term improvement after acupotomy in advanced ankylosing spondylitis with sacroiliac joint fusion
pmc-12741744.creator: Yu Chen, Zixi Ye, Yangguang Yuan, Xiangrui Cui, Dongyue Guo, Liyong Zhang, Qiuxia Ding
pmc-12741744.description: BackgroundEvidence for acupotomy in managing advanced ankylosing spondylitis (AS) with extensive bony fusion, particularly in treatment-refractory cases, remains limited. This report details its application and outcomes in one such patient.Case presentationA 27-year-old male with advanced, active AS and bilateral sacroiliac joint fusion presented with severe low back pain, kyphosis, and markedly restricted mobility.

pmc-12749375.title: Leveraging spatial-angular redundancy for self-supervised denoising of 3D fluorescence imaging without temporal dependency
pmc-12749375.creator: Zhi Lu, Wentao Chen, Feihao Sun, Jiaqi Fan, Xinyang Li, Zhenqi Fu, Manchang Jin, Jiamin Wu, Qionghai Dai
pmc-12749375.description: Photon noise is one of the fundamental limits in fluorescence imaging. Despite broad applications, existing self-supervised denoising methods rely on either temporal redundancy or spatial redundancy, leading to degradation in either temporal resolution or spatial resolution, especially for 3D imaging.

pmc-13219479.title: A novel hyperbolic tangent-augmented controller framework for temperature control in jacketed continuous stirred tank reactors
pmc-13219479.creator: Davut Izci, Serdar Ekinci, İrfan Ökten, Rıdvan Fırat Çınar, Mostafa Rashdan, Mohammad Salman, Burcu Bektaş Güneş, Mohd Ashraf Ahmad
pmc-13219479.description: Accurate temperature regulation of jacketed continuous stirred tank reactors (CSTRs) remains a challenging task due to strong nonlinearities, tight coupling between mass and energy balances, and sensitivity to disturbances and operating-point variations. In this study, a novel augmented proportional–integral–derivative (PID) controller incorporating a hyperbolic tangent nonlinearity (APID-T) is proposed for robust temperature control of an exothermic CSTR.

pmc-13247344.title: Identifying expression and DNA methylation biomarkers for lung adenocarcinoma risk in East Asia
pmc-13247344.creator: Tzu-Yu Chen, Li-Hsin Chien, Shih Sheng Jiang, Jiyeon Choi, Hsiao-Han Hung, Chin-Fu Hsiao, Jianxin Shi, Batel Blechter, Charles E Breeze, Gee-Chen Chang, Kuan-Yu Chen, Ying-Huang Tsai, Wu-Chou Su, Ming-Shyan Huang, Yuh-Min Chen, Yueh-Feng Wen, Chung-Yu Chen, Chih-Liang Wang, Fang-Yu Tsai, Hui-Ling Ch
pmc-13247344.description: BackgroundLung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is the most common type of lung cancer. A recent genome-wide association study of lung adenocarcinoma in East Asia reported 28 independent susceptibility variants across 25 loci and identified 2 genes whose genetically predicted expression levels are associated with lung adenocarcinoma risk, using an ancestry-matched lung tissue expression quantitative trait loci (QTL) dataset.

pmc-13534769.title: Incidence of Permanent Pacemaker Implantation Following Tricuspid Valve Surgeries: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13534769.creator: Seyed Shervin Shafiei, Saeid Hosseini, Samuel Heuts, Abolfazl Hosseinnataj, Peyman Sardari Nia
pmc-13534769.description: Objective:Tricuspid valve (TV) surgery is increasingly performed. Still, the risk of permanent pacemaker (PPM) implantation following TV surgery is a serious concern. Therefore, the present systematic review and meta-analysis is aimed to determine the incidence of PPM implantation following TV surgeries in various surgical settings.Methods:This study was preregistered in PROSPERO (CRD42024585421).

pmc-13559607.title: Physicians’ Experiences With Life-Threatening Illness and Return to Work
pmc-13559607.creator: Angela M. Ellison, Katherine Wu, Flynn Jones, Lanelle Quzack, Stephen R. Master, Joanne McCool, Lara Varpio
pmc-13559607.description: Key PointsQuestionWhat is the experience of physicians who have a life-threatening illness or medical event and attempt to return to work?FindingsIn this qualitative study of 22 physicians with life-threatening illnesses, participants often reported a clash between their professional and patient identities.
